title: Your blind date, Brayden, snaps his fingers at Andreas and calls the moussaka 'peasant lasagna.'

outcomes.text: 'He's not a waiter you snap at, he's the owner, and the moussaka is perfect.' Brayden leaves. Andreas brings you dessert.

options.label: Let it go
options.get: A smooth dinner, and Brayden pays

outcomes.text: You smile at your plate. Brayden pays, loudly, and leaves a 5% tip. Andreas says 'Opa' with zero enthusiasm.
You slip Andreas C$30 'for the trouble' and fake an early shift. Brayden finishes alone, explaining lasagna to nobody.

later.text: Remember tipping big after Brayden's 'peasant lasagna'? Andreas sent you home with a whole tray of baklava and a hug you didn't see coming.

title: On the rooftop, your date Sloane tells Kiki she's 'basically the help.' Kiki is smiling. Dangerously.

options.label: Stick up for Kiki
options.cost: The date, and the heat lamp

outcomes.text: 'Kiki runs this whole rooftop.' Sloane gasps theatrically and leaves. Kiki moves you to the best table, alone.

later.text: Remember sticking up for Kiki on the rooftop? You're on her list with a plus-one for life. She added a note: 'not Sloane.'

outcomes.text: You laugh. Sloane loves it. Kiki's smile doesn't move at all, which is worse than anything.

later.text: Remember laughing at 'basically the help' on the rooftop? Kiki's list somehow lost your name. For a while. 'Must be a typo, babe.'

outcomes.text: 'Is that the Chromecap Building?' It isn't. Sloane looks anyway. Kiki raises one eyebrow at you and walks off.

title: Downstairs on Main: your date haggles Wen down to half price, then posts the dumplings as 'my secret find.'

outcomes.text: While your date films, you slip Wen the other C$12. She nods once and adds a fried dumpling. 'For you. Not him.'

later.text: Remember paying Wen the rest of the haggled dumplings? She remembered. Your next order came with extra soup and a better table.

outcomes.text: 'Her stall's been here twenty years. She's the find.' Your date edits the caption to tag Wen. Then leaves early.
The dumplings are perfect. The deal was not. Your date tags it '#hiddengem.' Wen watches you leave without a word.

title: Your dinner date, Marisol, asks about the 'tech company' from your dating profile. It's a domain name.

options.label: Come clean
options.riskWhy: She might not find it charming

outcomes.text: 'It's a domain name. I bought it at 3 AM.' Marisol laughs so hard she snorts. Second date: confirmed.
'It's a domain.' Marisol nods slowly. 'So, nothing.' She's polite, pays half and heads home early.
'We're in stealth.' You describe the everything app. She's impressed. You're impressed. Nobody is in stealth.

later.text: Remember your 'tech company' on the date with Marisol? She looked it up: a parked domain selling luxury socks. The screenshot is in her group chat.

outcomes.text: 'It's more of a vibe than a company.' She squints, then laughs. You skate by, for now.

title: Your profile says you 'love hiking.' Your date just booked a 6 AM Bear Mountain trip for you both.

outcomes.text: 'I love the idea of hiking.' Your date laughs and swaps it for a walk round Astoria Park and a chopped cheese. Better plan.
You hike Bear Mountain in sneakers from Thread Count. You survive. Your calves file for divorce. Your date had fun.

options.label: Fake a cold
options.cost: A lie, and maybe the date

outcomes.text: 'Cough. So sad. Next time.' You sleep till ten. It's delicious.

later.text: Remember the cold you faked to skip Bear Mountain? You posted brunch at The Hub that same morning. Your date saw. The date's off.
